issue.title: Allow using a random test port within Google Cloud Function tests
issue.body:
Fixes #35476

I duplicated a `SocketUtil` class from the mailer extension, it may be a good idea to copy it to the `quarkus-test-common` module and share it between this extension and the mailer extension.

issue.title: google-cloud-functions allow using a random test port
issue.body:
google-cloud-functions allow using a random test port since 3.6.0

Issue reference: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/35476

issue.title: Random lambda mock event server port property does not work with funqy-amazon-lambda extension
issue.body:
### Describe the bug

Testing an application with RHBQ 3.27 using quarkus-funqy-amazon-lambda extension and random test port for lambda mock event server doesn't work.

### Expected behavior

```
mvn io.quarkus:quarkus-maven-plugin:3.27.0:create -DprojectGroupId=io.quarkus.qe -DprojectArtifactId=funqy-amazon-lambda -DprojectVersion=1.0.0-SNAPSHOT -Dextensions=funqy-amazon-lambda
cd funqy-amazon-lambda/
mvn verify -Dquarkus.http.test-port=0 -Dquarkus.lambda.mock-event-server.test-port=0 -Dquarkus.platform.version=3.27.0
```
Test passes.

cd funqy-amazon-lambda/
mvn verify -Dquarkus.http.test-port=0 -Dquarkus.lambda.mock-event-server.test-port=0 -Dquarkus.platform.version=3.27.0
.
.
